'''Pons Ora''' was one of the few [[City/Legends|settlements]] on the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Abafar/Legends|Abafar]]. It was located amidst the planetary desert known as [[The Void/Legends|The Void]]. It had [[Water/Legends|water]] quarries, which were quite rare on Abafar.

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] established a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] installation in Pons Ora.

Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Meebur Gascon/Legends|Meebur Gascon]] and the [[D-Squad/Legends|D-Squad]] crashed their [[Maxillipede shuttle/Legends|ship]] on Abafar, and after a long and exhausting wandering in the Void, they eventually found Pons Ora, with the help of the instincts of the [[Void Strider|flightless birds]] native to Abafar. Later on, the squad found [[Gregor/Legends|Gregor]], a [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] who lost his memories. Gregor helped the D-Squad to escape from the planet by stealing a [[Nu-class attack shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] from a [[Rhydonium mining installation/Legends|Rhydonium mining installation]]. However, he seemingly died during the process after he shot a barrel of [[Rhydonium/Legends|Rhydonium]] that caused a massive explosion.
